items.canonicalEnglishName: A-★ Japanese long onion, roughly diced
items.fdcDescription: Green onion, (scallion), bulb and greens, root removed, raw
items.notes: Explicit destination review accepts USDA raw green onion/scallion (bulb and greens, root removed) as a bounded nutrition reference for raw Japanese long onion/negi prepared by slicing, dicing, chopping, or shredding. The retained Foundation record does not certify Japanese cultivar, Allium species, geographic origin, white-to-green ratio, or trimming fraction. This binding is limited to uncooked long onion; cooked, pickled, dried, powdered, or composite onion identities remain separate. Nutrition remains per 100 g raw onion; no cut-size or garnish-serving mass conversion is inferred.
